evidence_refs.quote: Monthly Safe Force: The Monthly Force required to keep your Starship safe at the current level. The Monthly Safe Force challenge at each level is different. If your Monthly Force fails to meet the Level's Monthly Safe Force requirement, your Starship will be downgraded in the next month and your Overall Force will fall to the Attacked point.

Upgrade: After earning enough Overall Force, you will be able to upgrade your Starship.

When upgraded, your Starship will unlock a higher member capacity and other perks, but also have to meet a higher Monthly Safe Force requirement. The higher Monthly Safe Force requirement starts in the next month.

If you choose not to upgrade, the Monthly Safe Force requirement will remain the same, but you won't be able to grow your Starship with more new members and other perks.
The Monthly Safe Force of Level 1 Starship is '15000', and the Member Capacity is 10.
The Upgrade Force of Level 2 Starship is '150000', the Monthly Safe Force is '60000', and the Member Capacity is 15.
Rankings will be sorted according to the current Monthly Force, which will be counted from 0:00 (GMT+0) on the 1st of this month and automatically emptied for the following month.

rules.回报: 宣称最高500倍Beans；财富/魅力按实际Coins

evidence_refs.quote:
1. Send a Lucky Gift to automatically enter the draw for a chance to win up to 500× the gift's value in Beans.

Example: If you send a Lucky Gift worth 100 Beans and hit the 500× multiplier, you'll win 50,000 Beans.



2. When you send a Lucky Gift, the recipient receives a percentage of its value in Coins. The exact amount is shown in the gift details.



3. Any Beans won from a Lucky Gift are credited to your HeeSay account immediately.



4. Gift-related stats, such as Wealth Points, are calculated based on the number of Coins the recipient actually receives.

Example: If you send a Lucky Gift worth 1,000 Beans and the recipient receives 100 Coins, you will earn 0.1 Wealth Point.



5. Recipient-related stats, such as Charm Points, are calculated based on the actual number of Coins received.
